cards.front: What is the holy book of Christianity?
cards.back: The Bible - consisting of the Old Testament and New Testament

cards.front: Who is the central figure of Christianity?
cards.back: Jesus Christ - the Son of God and Savior of humanity

cards.front: What is the Trinity in Christianity?
cards.back: The belief in one God in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
The Anointed One - the Greek translation of the Hebrew 'Messiah'
Good News - the message of salvation through Jesus Christ

cards.front: What are the four Gospels in the New Testament?
cards.back: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John - the accounts of Jesus' life and teachings
One who is sent - the twelve disciples chosen by Jesus to spread his message
A follower or student - someone who follows Jesus' teachings
Deliverance from sin and eternal life with God through Jesus Christ
Unmerited favor - God's free gift of love and forgiveness
Trust and belief in God and his promises
Turning away from sin and turning toward God
A sacrament of initiation - being washed with water as a sign of new life
The Lord's Supper - sharing bread and wine in remembrance of Jesus
Communication with God - speaking to and listening to God
Honoring and praising God - expressing love and devotion to God
The body of believers - the community of Christians worldwide
A spiritual shepherd - a leader who guides and cares for a congregation
One who serves - a person who serves God and the church
A religious leader - someone who performs religious ceremonies and rituals
An overseer - a senior church leader who supervises multiple churches
A servant - a church leader who serves the congregation
A senior leader - an experienced church leader who provides guidance
A religious discourse - a talk given during worship service
A religious song - a song of praise and worship to God
A sacred song - a poem or song used in worship
A covenant or agreement - the Old and New Testaments of the Bible
A binding agreement - God's promise to his people
A message from God - a prediction or revelation from God
A supernatural event - an act that defies natural laws
A simple story - a story used to teach a moral or spiritual lesson
A divine rule - a law or instruction given by God
Wrongdoing - actions that go against God's will
Right living - living according to God's standards
Being set apart - being pure and dedicated to God
The process of becoming holy - being made pure and set apart for God
Being declared righteous - being made right with God through faith
Being bought back - being saved from sin and its consequences
Being restored - being brought back into relationship with God
Making amends - Jesus' death paying the price for human sin
Rising from the dead - Jesus' return to life after death
Going up - Jesus' return to heaven after his resurrection
The coming of the Holy Spirit - when the Holy Spirit descended on the disciples
Becoming flesh - God becoming human in Jesus Christ
Death on a cross - Jesus' execution by being nailed to a cross
Birth - the birth of Jesus Christ
Revelation - the manifestation of Jesus to the Gentiles
A period of fasting - the 40 days before Easter
Resurrection Sunday - the celebration of Jesus' resurrection
Christ's Mass - the celebration of Jesus' birth
Coming - the period before Christmas celebrating Jesus' coming

cards.front: What is the meaning of 'Good Friday'?
cards.back: The day of Jesus' crucifixion - commemorating his death on the cross

cards.front: What is the meaning of 'Palm Sunday'?
cards.back: The day Jesus entered Jerusalem - when people waved palm branches

cards.front: What is the meaning of 'Maundy Thursday'?
cards.back: The day of the Last Supper - when Jesus shared his final meal with disciples
